header.description: Backend flow for handling work order logic

data.query:
query WorkOrder($where: WorkOrderWhereInput, $orderBy: [WorkOrderOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  workOrder(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        priority
        quantity
        active
        buildToOrder
        buildToStock
        kanban
        customerReference
        description
        extProduct
        externalId
        orderReference
        actualFinishAt
        actualStartAt
        scheduledFinishAt
        scheduledStartAt
        dueAt
        earliestStartAt
        customData
        integrationData
        productId
        productStrategyId
        workOrderStatusId
        workOrderProcesses {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              name
              sequence
              standardPackQuantity
              unitWeight
              active
              description
              extWorkOrderProcess
              externalId
              note
              customData
              integrationData
              workOrderId
              documentDesignId
              imageId
              processId
              processId
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

data.mutation:
mutation CreateWorkOrderProcessDistribution(
  $workOrderProcessPayload: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionCreatePayloadInput!]!
  $workOrderPayload: [WorkOrderUpdatePayloadInput!]!
  $dependencyPayload: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionDependencyCreatePayloadInput!]!
) {
  createWorkOrderProcessDistribution(payload: $workOrderProcessPayload) {
    id
    dispatchSequence
    unitPerCycle
    balanceQuantity
    producedQuantity
    productionOperators
    quantity
    setupOperators
    active
    extWorkunit
    group
    actualFinishAt
    actualStartAt
    scheduledFinishAt
    scheduledStartAt
    customData
    integrationData
    cycleDuration
    idealDuration
    processDuration
    scheduledDuration
    setupDuration
    standardDuration
    transitAfter
    transitBefore
    distributionStatusId

    leadingDistributionId
    workOrderProcessId
    workunitId
  }
  updateWorkOrder(payload: $workOrderPayload) {
    id
  }
  createWorkOrderProcessDistributionDependency(payload: $dependencyPayload) {
    id
    childWorkOrderProcessDistributionId
    parentWorkOrderProcessDistributionId
  }
}
